concerns.text: The goal to 'generate... structural adjacency matrices' in US-1 is unbacked by any Functional Requirement. While FR-002 covers downloading dMRI and FR-009 covers thresholding the matrix, there is no FR specifying the actual generation of the matrix (e.g., via tractography and atlas mapping as described in the Idea Md).
Naming inconsistency: 'SC-07' should be 'SC-007' to match the three-digit naming convention used in all other success criteria (e.g., SC-001, SC-006).

FR-009 leaves the primary structural density threshold as a '[deferred]' placeholder, yet the Assumptions section declares a primary threshold of 15 % and FR-016 sweeps only 10 %, 20 % and 30 %. The spec never defines a concrete primary structural threshold, creating a contradiction between requirement and design.

SC-006 expects a `data_availability_report.txt` file, while FR-019 specifies the report name as `data_completeness_report.txt`. This mismatch makes it unclear which artifact the success criterion refers to, violating internal consistency of naming.

The spec redefines the primary predictor (X). The idea explicitly requires 'no arbitrary correlation threshold; the full weighted matrix is used,' but FR-006 and FR-008 mandate a 0.6 threshold and calculate X only from edges that survive it.

Under-reach: The spec drops the requirement to test alternative centrality measures (betweenness, degree) in the sensitivity analysis, which was explicitly requested in the idea's 'Sensitivity checks' section.
Under-reach: The spec omits the band-pass filter (0.01–0.1 Hz) explicitly required in the idea's functional preprocessing section.
Over-reach: The spec adds several unrequested features: OSF pre-registration (FR-007), MDES calculation (FR-015), MST augmentation for visualization (FR-018), and a computation audit log (FR-021).

new_concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-008 is not anchored to any User Story; it only references assumptions. Every SC must be linked to a story. Add a reference (e.g., to US‑2) or remove/reframe the criterion.

FR-009 still contains the placeholder "[deferred]" for the primary structural density threshold. The Assumptions section declares a primary threshold of 15 %, and FR-016 sweeps only 10 %, 20 %, and 30 %. This leaves the specification without a concrete primary threshold, contradicting both the assumptions and downstream requirements.

The idea explicitly states a primary structural density threshold of 15 % (Methodology sketch), but the spec defers the threshold (`[deferred]`) and only defines sensitivity thresholds of 10 %, 20 %, and 30 % (FR‑016). This omits the required 15 % primary threshold, constituting an under‑reach of the original research specification.
